parties.respondent: Office of Lieutenant Governor of Delhi & Ors

summary: Right to vote of nominated aldermen under Delhi Municipal Corporation Act; constitutional interpretation of Article 243R(2)(a)(i) proviso and Section 3(3)(b)(i) proviso; restriction on voting applies to all meetings including first meeting for Mayor election; rejection of dual-meeting interpretation; regulation sequencing of Mayor-Deputy Mayor elections; constitutional value on nominated members' experience without voting rights.
legal_provisions_cited: Delhi Municipal Corporation (Procedure and Conduct of Business) Regulations 1958 Reg 7, Reg 8
final_judgment: Petition allowed; nominated aldermen disqualified from voting in Mayor election; elections to proceed excluding nominated members' votes.
